# Avsnitt 603 - Sveriges bästa rapporttrader

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-10-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts discuss a choppy week: an AI sell-off triggered by CoreWeave's unsecured bonds yielding 15% gave way to a sharp rebound on rumours of an Iran deal, as oil and interest rates fell. Money is rotating out of AI and neocloud names into old-economy and value stocks. One host argues Eutelsat is Europe's only real alternative to Starlink/Starshield. The hosts also go long property (Balder), copper (Viscaria) and a few AI rebound trades. The US midterm elections and Brazil's election are flagged as event risks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ETL — Eutelsat | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Only European sovereign satellite option, technical lead of IRIS²; host thinks the market misreads it; target talk of €3.

#### Reasoning

Guest/host thesis: the US cutting Starshield for Ukraine shows Europe needs its own constellation. Eutelsat is the only European operator (world's 3rd largest), already in orbit with funded replacement plans, and technical lead of IRIS². Satellite makers like Airbus and Thales build for it. The stock at €1.70 is below where it started the year; the host says the market does not grasp that there is no alternative.

#### Sell Triggers

- Europe chooses a non-Eutelsat solution
- financing problems
- IRIS² delays or cuts

> *"Det finns ingen annan potentiell aktör. Kommer inte hända."*

---

### 🟢 BALD-B — Balder | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host bought shares and new calls; rates have fallen without property moving, and the sector is hated.

#### Reasoning

Host expects a catch-up bounce in Swedish property as rates fall, helped by an Iran deal lowering oil and rates. Previous calls expired worthless, so this is a renewed tactical bet.

#### Sell Triggers

- Iran deal collapses and rates rise
- no bounce materialises

> *"Köpt lite Balder idag. Jag hade ju massa calls här som gick ut. Gör ett nytt försök nu."*

---

### 🟢 VISC — Viscaria | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Bought after a sell-off; host expects the loan consortium to be secured and copper supply to stay tight.

#### Reasoning

Host bought after a crash triggered by a Twitter profile selling. The industry is conservative on copper prices, so this is not a bubble; demand from EVs and AI is strong and new supply is slow to arrive. Delays are now priced in, giving more of a cushion. Not dirt cheap, but not expensive.

#### Sell Triggers

- failure to secure loan financing
- further project delays
- copper price collapse

> *"Den är inte pissbillig här. Men jag tycker inte den är dyr."*

---

### 🟢 NBIS — Nebius | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host went long during the recording on the AI rebound; owns it but calls the sector volatile and crowded.

#### Reasoning

Short-term trade on the AI bounce after the Iran-deal rumour. The host warns the move may be a dead-cat bounce and that the sector is crowded.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI sentiment turns down again
- CoreWeave funding stress worsens

> *"Jag långade Nibius här. Jag är upp 3% sen vi började spela in."*

---

### 🟢 AKER — Aker | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Bought as an AI-bounce play via its neocloud stake after an 8% drop.

#### Reasoning

Aker is a major owner of a neocloud that may list. The stock fell 8% after the Korean neocloud IPO flop; host bought for a possible AI bounce but is unsure how long he will hold.

#### Sell Triggers

- neocloud IPO valuation cut
- AI sell-off resumes

> *"Som Aker, den köpte jag lite idag. Får se hur länge jag håller"*

---

### 🟡 LUMI — Lundin Mining | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host is long and wants to add more at 200.

#### Reasoning

Host holds the position and would like to add on a dip to 200, in line with his wish to buy commodity stocks after a pullback.

#### Sell Triggers

- copper price collapse

> *"Lumi är ju lång Jag vill gärna bli lång på 200."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

15% yield on unsecured bonds signals high default risk; weak cash flows and dependence on new funding.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see CoreWeave as the canary in the coal mine for AI funding. Rising yields on secured bonds (toward 7-8%) would be serious. They call the AI space crowded and suggest looking at other things.

#### Sell Triggers

- bond buyback or Nvidia-backed refinancing
- secured yields fall

> *"Så det är väl lite en kanariefågel i gruvan."*

---

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Good report but fell 6% as an AI proxy; host found it buyable but chose index exposure.

#### Reasoning

Data-centre growth was strong, but the stock trades on AI sentiment. The host was unsure the AI sell-off was over, so he bought the OMX index instead.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI rotation deepens

> *"Jag tyckte att när de var ner sådär mycket idag båda två, så båda var ju köpvärda."*

---

### 🟠 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Dropped sharply as an AI proxy; called buyable on weakness.

#### Reasoning

Same reasoning as ABB: AI-proxy flows drove the fall, so the host sees it as buyable on weakness but preferred the index.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI rotation deepens

> *"båda var ju köpvärda. Men jag valde att köpa index istället."*

---

### 🟠 BETCO — Better Collective | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Brazil election this weekend; a Bolsonaro win is seen as positive for betting.

#### Reasoning

Bolsonaro is pro-betting and favourite on Polymarket (77%). The election outcome could act as a catalyst for Brazil-exposed gambling stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- Bolsonaro loses the election

> *"Ja, vi har val i Brasilien idag. Det blir väl intressant för Bet Collective."*

---
